Value: A total sample size of 430 is required to detect a difference in response proportions between the treatment and control groups based on a two-sided Fisher’s exact test with desired power 87%. The significance level is 0.035, the proportion of responses in the control group and treatment groups are 0.05 and 0.002 respectively. Since the allocation ratio is 1, of the 430 subjects, 215 are allocated to the control arm and 215 are allocated to the treatment arm.
